pr.title: fix(github): catch self-merges/closes via a recently-closed PR sweep
pr.body: Closes #86. Catch self-merges/closes of your own PRs. navi missed merges/closes you perform yourself: GitHub never notifies you about your own actions, and the involved-PR sweep was `is:open`, so a PR that already merged had left the search and its transition was never seen. (Diagnosed by dogfooding the 0.2.3 stack merge: only #85 alerted, and only by a race — it merged ~5s before a sweep while GitHub's search index still listed it open.) ### Fix Add a second involved-PR sweep for recently-**closed** PRs, generalizing the `state=all` + `updated_after` approach already used by the GitLab source (#17): - `recently_closed_prs`: `is:closed is:pr involves:me updated:>=`, bounded by a new `pr_closed_since` cursor (advanced each poll with the standard overlap) so it doesn't rescan history. Second-precision timestamp — GitHub search's `updated:` qualifier rejects subseconds. - Skipped on the very first poll (no cursor yet) so it baselines forward instead of replaying every old closed PR. - Both sweeps now share a `diff_swept_prs` helper (search loop extracted to `search_prs`), so there's no duplicated per-PR logic. A closed PR surfaces once on its merge/close bump, diffs against the stored open snapshot, and fires `Merged`/`Closed`. Covers the self-close miss (#21) too. ### Tests `self_merged_pr_is_caught_by_the_closed_sweep`: open search returns empty (PR already merged), closed search returns the merged PR, and navi fires exactly one `Merged`. Existing involved-PR tests unaffected (closed sweep is skipped without the cursor, i.e. on a first poll). Closes #86 - 🟣 ~~[feat(discord): group a PR's events into a reply chain in bot mode (#97)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/97)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(source): honor general.backfill on gitlab and gitea too (#96)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/96)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(gitea): sweep involved PRs to catch self-merges and own-PR activity (#95)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/95)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(gitlab): honor general.comment_min_age_secs when diffing MR notes (#94)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/94)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(github): log a per-poll summary of what each poll examined (#89)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/89)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(github): catch self-merges/closes via a recently-closed PR sweep (#88)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/navi/pull/88)~~ (merged) 👈 - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: The involved-sweep pr: cursor is written before delivery, so a failed send on a closed PR (frozen updated_at) drops the event permanently.
